OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized by removing every non-digit character and must contain
            exactly 10 digits; the stored and returned value is those 10 digits.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer

All tests pass with a clean build. Here's a summary of what I implemented.

## Summary

Added optional `email` support to owners: when present it must be a syntactically valid address, and it's stored/returned lower-cased; an invalid value yields `400`.

### Changes

**Validation (400 on invalid)** — declarative, matching how the other owner fields are validated:
- `src/main/resources/openapi.yml`: added an optional `email` property to the `OwnerFields` schema with `format: email` (and `maxLength: 255`). The generator (`performBeanValidation=true`) emits `@Email` on `OwnerFieldsDto`, so an invalid address fails the `@Valid` pass and `ExceptionControllerAdvice` maps `MethodArgumentNotValidException` → `400`.

**Model / persistence:**
- `model/Owner.java`: new `email` field (`@Column(name = "email")`, `@Email`) with getter/setter.
- `db/{hsqldb,h2,postgres,mysql}/schema.sql`: added the `email` column to the `owners` table.
